arguments.name: Review_Cover_4K
arguments.prompt: Create a finished, premium 16:9 video cover for a test-edit project named REVIEW. Its actual footage consists of broadcast color test bars: vivid red, green, yellow, blue, magenta and cyan vertical stripes, a diagonal rainbow streak, and small checkerboard signal patterns. Translate those observed elements into a polished contemporary graphic poster. Deep near-black background; a beautifully composed luminous color-bar panel occupying the right half, with subtle glass depth, crisp geometric edges and finely controlled reflections; one elegant diagonal spectrum ribbon links the panel to the left. Large, perfectly spelled, bold white editorial typography 'REVIEW' on the left, with the small secondary caption 'COLOR / MOTION / SOUND'. Strong visual hierarchy, restrained spacing, high contrast, premium studio quality, sophisticated clean composition that remains legible as a small thumbnail. Keep generous margins and important content inside the central 80 percent. No people, no landscapes, no invented brand logos, no timecodes, no UI screenshots, no watermark. Produce genuinely detailed, crisp 4K artwork with smooth gradients and no compression artifacts.
